mapper.select: SELECT ucao.id AS orderId, dma.id AS doctorMerchantId, ucao.user_id AS userId, ucao.user_order_status AS userOrderStatus, dma.cost AS merchantPrice, dma.begin_date AS beginDate FROM user_appointment_order AS ucao INNER JOIN doctor_merchant_appointment AS dma ON ucao.doctor_merchant_appointment_id = dma.id WHERE ucao.id = #{orderId} FOR UPDATE
